images.filename: City buses to the Quebec side are blue- white (20564125760).jpg
images.caption: While the ubiquitous red- white city buses on Ottawa's British (Ontario) buses are run by OC Transpo, on the French (Quebec) side, the city bus operator is Société de Transport de l’Outaouais. Here instead of red- white, the buses are characterised by turquoise- white livery. Here is one of the buses from the Quebec on a routine run on Queen's St. Although these are two separate operators, buses cross freely from the Ontario to the Quebec side and vice versa, though inside their territories, local services are run by their own operator. (Ottawa, Canada, June 2015)
